name: Open a PR from the list and load its review detail
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click into PR #482 and confirm the detail route loads with the PR title and review surface. Exercises nested routing (/repos/<id>/pulls/<number>) and the per-PR detail fetch. The seed holds two repos and listByWorkspace has no ORDER BY, so the flow guards that the home redirect landed on acme/payments-api before asserting anything about it, and opens the PR by title rather than by row position (#482 has a NULL updated_at and sorts behind #479). See e2e/README.md.
